title: Export a Watch Later snapshot to a local JSON file
summary: Make the extension usable on day one: load it on youtube.com, detect the Watch Later playlist page, capture visible items, normalize them, and save a deduplicated snapshot file locally.
userJourney: As a user with a large Watch Later backlog, I can export my current queue into a portable JSON snapshot without needing any server or OAuth setup.
deliverables: Manifest V3 extension shell wired to the Watch Later page
content-script DOM scan for title, channel, duration, URL, thumbnail, and date added when available
shared normalized snapshot shape in packages/core
download or copy flow that produces a deduplicated JSON snapshot
testableOutcome: Run `npm install` and `npm run build`, add `apps/extension` to Safari with `Add Temporary Extension…`, open https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=WL, trigger export from the popup, and confirm the downloaded JSON contains normalized entries for the videos currently loaded on the page.

title: Import one snapshot into a persistent local catalog
summary: Turn a snapshot into a usable local product slice by letting the user import the file, persist it in extension-managed storage, and reopen the catalog later.
userJourney: As a user, I can import a snapshot once and come back later without rescanning YouTube just to see my backlog.
deliverables: snapshot import UI in an extension page
browser-local storage for imported snapshots and derived catalog entries
import validation and deduplication against existing catalog items
catalog landing page that reloads persisted data on open
testableOutcome: Open the catalog/options page, import a snapshot, close the page, reopen it, and confirm the same catalog entries still exist in extension-local storage without re-importing.

title: Search and filter the imported backlog end-to-end
summary: Make the first catalog slice useful by supporting search and a small set of practical filters directly against persisted imported data.
userJourney: As a user, I can narrow a large imported backlog by title, channel, duration, and import recency so I can actually find something to act on.
deliverables: search by title and channel
filters for duration bucket and import recency
catalog state that updates from local persisted data only
empty and no-results states that make the catalog understandable
testableOutcome: Import a snapshot into the catalog, search for a known title or channel, apply duration and import-recency filters, and confirm the visible list updates correctly from persisted local data only.

title: Open a video detail view that combines imported fields cleanly
summary: Add a focused detail view so an item in the local catalog becomes inspectable and actionable instead of staying a flat row in a list.
userJourney: As a user, I can open one backlog item and review the imported metadata, thumbnail, and YouTube link before deciding what to do next.
deliverables: detail panel or route launched from the catalog
display of imported snapshot fields from the shared domain model
deep link back to the YouTube watch page
clear handling for missing optional fields such as thumbnail or duration
testableOutcome: From the catalog, select a video and confirm the detail view shows the imported metadata, import history, and a link back to the YouTube watch page.

title: Enrich selected catalog items with YouTube metadata
summary: Introduce OAuth and YouTube Data API access only when it powers a complete user workflow: choose items, fetch richer metadata, cache it locally, and show it in the detail view.
userJourney: As a user, I can authorize once, enrich selected videos, and immediately see the extra context that helps me decide whether to keep or move them.
deliverables: OAuth setup for YouTube Data API access
batch enrichment for selected imported videos
cached metadata refresh behavior in local storage
detail view that merges imported data with enriched metadata such as published date, description, tags, stats, and availability
testableOutcome: Authorize the extension, enrich at least one catalog item, reopen its detail view, and confirm the enriched fields persist locally.

title: Assign a topic with auto-suggestions and manual override
summary: Deliver the first organization slice by suggesting a topic and format for each video, while making the user-confirmed label the source of truth.
userJourney: As a user, I can take a suggested label, accept it or correct it, and trust that my explicit topic choice is what downstream features use.
deliverables: rules-based topic and format suggestions
manual relabeling flow from the catalog or detail view
saved topic buckets such as WL - AI or WL - Comedy
separate storage for suggested versus confirmed labels
testableOutcome: Generate a suggestion for a video, override it manually, reload the catalog, and confirm the confirmed topic persists and wins over the suggestion.

title: Build a watch-next queue for a chosen time budget
summary: Use imported and enriched data plus confirmed labels to generate a practical queue for a real viewing session instead of just a categorized catalog.
userJourney: As a user, I can pick 15, 30, 60, or 120 minutes and get a ranked queue with enough explanation to trust the recommendations.
deliverables: rules-based priority scoring
duration-aware queue generation
freshness boosts for time-sensitive content
manual boost and deprioritize controls reflected in the queue
testableOutcome: Choose a time budget, generate a queue, adjust a video's priority, and confirm the resulting queue updates in a way that matches the rule set.

title: Review a dry-run playlist sync plan before writing to YouTube
summary: Convert confirmed topics into concrete playlist actions that can be inspected and approved before any mutation occurs on the user's YouTube account.
userJourney: As a user, I can preview what videos would move to which playlists and approve only the changes I trust.
deliverables: suggested target playlist names from confirmed topics
bulk review workflow with approve and unapprove controls
dry-run action preview showing intended creates and inserts
audit trail of proposed versus approved moves
testableOutcome: Generate a sync plan from labeled videos, review the dry-run output, approve a subset, and confirm only the approved actions remain selected for execution.

title: Sync approved videos into user-created topic playlists
summary: Finish the first full reorganization loop by creating or reusing user playlists, inserting approved videos safely, and recording what happened.
userJourney: As a user, I can take reviewed playlist changes and apply them to YouTube without duplicating items or losing track of failures.
deliverables: playlist creation and lookup
duplicate-safe inserts
sync execution log with per-item results
explicit failure handling for quota, permissions, and unavailable videos
testableOutcome: Approve a playlist sync plan, run sync, and confirm that YouTube playlists reflect the approved actions while the extension records successes and failures.

title: Resume interrupted scans and make degraded catalog states visible
summary: Harden the main workflows for a 3,700+ video backlog by making long-running work resumable and degraded video states visible throughout the product.
userJourney: As a user, I can recover from interruptions and still understand which videos are unavailable, deleted, or partially processed.
deliverables: resumable snapshot import and enrichment jobs
progress reporting for long scans and enrichments
catalog states for deleted, private, and unavailable videos
partial failure recovery that preserves completed work
testableOutcome: Interrupt an import, enrichment, or sync flow, resume it, and confirm completed work is preserved while degraded video states remain visible in the catalog.

title: Decide when extension-only stops being the right architecture
summary: After the core local-first slices exist, evaluate whether storage, UX, or performance pressure justify a local companion app with SQLite and Drizzle.
userJourney: As the maintainer, I can make an explicit architecture decision based on real product pressure instead of prematurely introducing a second runtime.
deliverables: decision criteria tied to measured storage and UX constraints
thresholds for when extension pages become too limiting
migration sketch for a local companion app if the threshold is crossed
clear recommendation to stay extension-only or introduce a companion runtime
testableOutcome: Review the documented criteria against observed product behavior and record a decision with enough detail to guide the next implementation phase.
